scenes.text: Imagine standing in the absolute center of the scorching Sahara desert, with absolutely nothing but endless sand dunes stretching for over two hundred and fifty miles in every single direction.

Right there, completely alone in the dust, stood a single ancient acacia tree that became famous as the most isolated tree on Earth, miraculously surviving by sending its roots over a hundred feet deep down for water.
But in 1973, the impossible happened when a lone truck driver somehow navigated across hundreds of miles of empty, flat desert and managed to crash directly into the only living obstacle in sight.
This bizarre accident ended a centuries-old wonder in the most ridiculous way possible, so tell me what you think in the comments and follow for more insane history!
